episodes.synopsis: With the great alchemist slain and the dissection of the world stopped, it's time for Hibiki to face her greatest enemy yet: summer homework!
episodes.title: Hell at Val Verde

episodes.synopsis: The Bavarian Illuminati has struck at SONG in a small South American country. It's up to the Symphogear wielders to fight them off and gain time for the non-combatants to escape.
episodes.title: Last Resort

episodes.synopsis: The Bavarian Illuminati has followed SONG to Japan, and has a powerful new kind of Alca-Noise that they're using to trap the Symphogear wielders. Can they escape?
episodes.title: A Horoscope Drawn by Gears

episodes.synopsis: SONG brings the Val Verde documents to a secret base dating from World War 2, but the Illuminati tracks them there as well.
episodes.title: Golden Transmutation

episodes.synopsis: Adam, the controlling director of the Illuminati, has used a powerful alchemic spell to destroy the Kazanari Organization's base. Now it's up to SONG to deal with the fallout.
episodes.title: Risking Your Life in a Fictional Warzone

episodes.synopsis: The goal of the Alchemists is revealed as they try to stop the Symphogears from halting their march towards a more perfect world. Their final goal? The lunar ruins.
episodes.title: Surfacing From the Suicide Zone

episodes.synopsis: Shirabe and Kirika engage the Alchemists while the remainder of the team searches for a secret item that will allow them to use their Ignite Modules.
episodes.title: ARCANA No. 00

episodes.synopsis: The wielders find the Fool's Stone, and can now use their powerful Ignite modules against their alchemist foes. Cagliostro is the first to challenge them and their new power...
episodes.title: In the Gap Between Past and Future

episodes.synopsis: The group trains so that everyone can pair with any other team member and use their powerful Unison attacks. But Shirabe is having trouble pairing up with anybody but Kirika, because of her inability to trust others.
episodes.title: Blue Bunny

episodes.synopsis: With what they've learned from the shrine, the Symphogear wielders now know the full extent of the Illumanti's plan: they're going to use an ancient gate to summon the power of a god. Only one person can stop them: Hibiki, the "God-Slayer".
episodes.title: An Tiki Thera

episodes.synopsis: The power of stars descends on Tiki. Despite the best efforts of the Symphogear wielders, and some unexpected help, she completes the ritual and becomes a divine weapon.
episodes.title: Ultimate Apotheosis

episodes.synopsis: The divine power chooses Hibiki as its vessel. To stop the worldwide disaster she could cause, the U.S. initiates a wide-scale attack on Japan.
episodes.title: AXZ

episodes.synopsis: Adam throws aside his pride and beauty and assumes the form of a huge monster. It will take the power of all six Symphogear wielders to bring him down.
episodes.title: Every Time Tears Overlap, the Reality Proven Is...
